title: "Contact"
description: "Book a Google Meet call or send SisengAI a message."
toc: false
---

::: {.hero-section .contact-hero}
<span class="eyebrow-line">Start with one workflow</span>

# Book a call or send a considered note.

<p class="hero-subtitle">Bring the repetitive task you want to improve. We’ll decide whether it is a sensible candidate for automation and what to do next.</p>

<div class="meeting-card">
  <div class="meeting-icon">G</div>
  <div><strong>AI automation fit call</strong><p>20 minutes · Google Meet · booking confirmation arrives by email</p></div>
  <a href="https://calendar.app.google/d7Ttfbm1Masri4vB8" class="btn btn-primary">Choose a time</a>
</div>
:::

::: {.contact-note-section}
<div class="contact-note-intro">
  <span class="section-label">Prefer email?</span>
  <h2>Tell me what you are trying to improve.</h2>
  <p>A little context is enough: the work that repeats, who does it now, and what a better outcome would look like.</p>
  <p class="contact-note-detail">Your message is addressed to <a href="mailto:Ricky.Macharm@SisengAI.com">Ricky.Macharm@SisengAI.com</a>.</p>
</div>

<form id="email-contact-form" class="email-contact-form">
  <div class="contact-form-grid">
    <p><label for="contact-name">Your name</label><input id="contact-name" name="name" autocomplete="name" required></p>
    <p><label for="contact-email">Your email</label><input id="contact-email" name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email" required></p>
  </div>
  <p><label for="contact-subject">What would you like to discuss?</label><input id="contact-subject" name="subject" placeholder="For example: an AI assistant for client research" required></p>
  <p><label for="contact-message">A little context</label><textarea id="contact-message" name="message" rows="6" placeholder="What is happening now, and what would you like to be easier?" required></textarea></p>
  <div class="contact-form-action"><button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Open my email and send message <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></button><p id="contact-form-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p></div>
</form>
:::

<script>
(() => {
  const form = document.querySelector("#email-contact-form");
  const status = document.querySelector("#contact-form-status");
  form.addEventListener("submit", (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!form.reportValidity()) return;
    const name = document.querySelector("#contact-name").value.trim();
    const email = document.querySelector("#contact-email").value.trim();
    const subject = document.querySelector("#contact-subject").value.trim();
    const message = document.querySelector("#contact-message").value.trim();
    const body = "Hello Ricky,\n\nName: " + name + "\nEmail: " + email + "\n\n" + message + "\n\n— Sent from the SisengAI website";
    window.location.href = "mailto:Ricky.Macharm@SisengAI.com?subject=" + encodeURIComponent(subject) + "&body=" + encodeURIComponent(body);
    status.textContent = "Your email app should now be open with this message ready to send.";
  });
})();
</script>
